source_text: Si in praeceptis meis ambulaveritis, dabo pluvias. Pluvia doctrinae. Terra cordis germinat.
pass_a_gloss: If in precepts my you-will-have-walked, I-will-give rains. Rain of-teaching. Earth of-heart sprouts.
pass_b_english: [[If you walk in my precepts, I will give rains in season >> Bible:Leviticus 26:3-4]]. Teaching’s rain. The heart’s earth sprouts.
